scripts.build: vite build && node -e 'const fs = require("node:fs"); const path = "dist/src/pages"; for (const file of fs.readdirSync(path).filter((name) => name.endsWith(".html"))) { const html = fs.readFileSync(`${path}/${file}`, "utf8").replaceAll("../../assets/", "assets/"); fs.writeFileSync(`dist/${file}`, html); }'
